unknowns.question: AutoSwarm's outcome vocabulary, including cancelled calls
unknowns.resolution: Exactly three TERMINAL outcomes - completed, failed, cancelled (runner.py; result initializes failed; no timeout/stale outcome exists). An absent result record proves only that no terminal outcome has been observed - never that the call is running; running/stale status comes from separate durable lifecycle evidence (t-a03 witnesses; t-a12 staleness). Frozen mapping D-C3-4: completed -> success, failed/cancelled verbatim, unknown strings verbatim and never success; the frozen completion_policies decide (C3-M2, 2026-11-12; missing-result semantics per the operator's pre-commit correction)
